Kuna buƙatar Wi-Fi da Android 11 ko sabo. Ana haɗawa sau ɗaya ne kawai; bayan wayar ta sake kunnuwa, mataki na 7 kaɗai za ku maimaita.

1. Haɗa wayar da Wi-Fi.

2. Kunna saitunan “Developer options”: a saitunan waya, “Settings” › “About phone” › “Software information” › taɓa “Build number” sau 7. (A wasu wayoyi: “Settings” › “About phone” › “Build number”.)

3. Buɗe Shizuku. Idan ya nemi izinin nuna sanarwa, ku amince: ana rubuta lambar haɗawa a cikin sanarwar Shizuku.

4. A cikin Shizuku, ƙarƙashin “Start via Wireless debugging”, taɓa “Pairing”. A shafin da ya buɗe, taɓa “Developer options”, kunna “Wireless debugging” sannan ku tabbatar da “Allow”.

5. Taɓa kalmomin “Wireless debugging” (ba makunnin ba), sannan “Pair device with pairing code” (haɗa waya da lamba). Lamba mai lambobi 6 za ta bayyana.

6. Ku bar wannan shafin a buɗe sannan ku ja sanarwa ƙasa. Idan sanarwar Shizuku ta ce “Pairing service found”, taɓa “Enter pairing code” sannan ku rubuta lambar. Shizuku zai ce haɗawa ta yi nasara.

7. Koma Shizuku sannan ku taɓa “Start” ƙarƙashin “Start via Wireless debugging”. Ku jira har sai ya ce “Shizuku is running”.

8. Dawo Waaiya sannan ku taɓa “Ba da izini”, sannan “Allow”.

A nuna rubutun sanarwa yayin tacewa?

Android yana ɓoye rubutun sanarwa yayin da wata manhaja ke ɗaukar allo, kuma ana ɗaukar tacewa a matsayin haka. Waaiya zai iya kashe wannan kariya yayin da yake tacewa, kuma yana sake kunna ta idan tacewa ta tsaya.\n\nYayin da take a kashe, raba allo a lokaci guda (kiran bidiyo, misali) zai iya nuna sanarwarku da lambobinku ga wasu.

Buɗe Waaiya sannan ku sake yin saitin sau ɗaya (“Wireless debugging”, Shizuku ko kwamfuta). Yanzu yana ba da izini ga wannan maɓallin saitunan gaggawa ma. A wayoyin Xiaomi, ku fara kunna “USB debugging (Security settings)” a cikin saitunan “Developer options”.
Saitin sau ɗaya a wannan waya, da hotuna. Hotunan daga waya ɗaya suke: a taku, menu na iya bambanta kaɗan, amma sunayen iri ɗaya ne.

Kunna saitunan “Developer options”: a cikin saitunan waya “Settings” › “About phone”, taɓa “Build number” sau 7 (a wasu wayoyi yana ƙarƙashin “Software information”). Tsallake wannan idan “Developer options” suna kunne tuni.
A cikin Waaiya, a shafin Saiti, taɓa maɓallin Buɗe saitunan “Developer options”. Waaiya zai buɗe “Developer options” ya kuma nuna sanarwa.
Ku gungura ƙasa zuwa “Wireless debugging” (ƙarƙashin “Debugging”) sannan ku taɓa sunansa, ba makunnin ba.
Kunna “Use wireless debugging” sannan ku tabbatar da “Allow”.
Taɓa “Pair device with pairing code” (haɗa waya da lamba).
Lamba mai lambobi 6 za ta bayyana. Ku bar wannan shafi a buɗe.
Ku ja sanarwa ƙasa. A cikin sanarwar Waaiya, taɓa “Shigar da lamba”.
Rubuta lambobi 6 sannan ku taɓa alamar aikawa.
Waaiya zai kammala da kansa ya ce “An gama saiti”. Yanzu kuna iya kashe “Wireless debugging”, sai dai idan Waaiya ya ce yana amfani da mataimakinsa a wayarku.

• Ba ku sami wani menu ba: ku yi amfani da wurin bincike da ke saman saitunan waya “Settings” ku rubuta “Build number” ko “Wireless debugging”.
• “Wireless debugging” yana buƙatar Wi-Fi (ba a buƙatar intanet). Ba tare da Wi-Fi ba ba zai kunnu ba.
• Babu “Shigar da lamba” a cikin sanarwar (sanarwar Waaiya a kashe take, ko wayar tana ɓoye wurin rubutu): ku buɗe “Settings” da Waaiya gefe da gefe (raba allo) sannan ku taɓa “Rubuta lambar a nan” a cikin Waaiya.
• Ba a karɓi lambar ba: tana canzawa duk lokacin da aka buɗe shafin haɗawa. Ku sake buɗe shi ku rubuta sabuwar lambar.
Jagoran Shizuku shi ma yana nuna matakansa da hotuna. Shizuku kuma yana barin taɓawa ta ratsa murfin allo.
Waaiya zai iya yi wa ainihin sautin sauran manhajoji shiru. Ku sake yin sa ne kawai idan wani abu ya canza (an soke saitin, ko Waaiya ya ce babu shi).

Ba tare da taimako ba, murfi yana hana taɓawa da ke ƙarƙashinsa. Mataimakin Waaiya yana zana murfin ta yadda taɓawa ke ratsawa. Kunna “Wireless debugging” (ana buƙatar Wi-Fi) sannan ku taɓa maɓallin; a karon farko, ku yi haɗawa sau ɗaya kamar a saiti. Bayan wayar ta sake kunnuwa, ku sake taɓa shi.
Mataimakin Waaiya yana zana murfin: taɓawa tana ratsa su. Yana tsayawa idan wayar ta sake kunnuwa ko idan an kashe “USB debugging”; sai ku sake taɓa maɓallin.
Shizuku yana zana murfin: taɓawa tana ratsa su.

Idan dusashe allo yana kunne, saitin yana kuma kunna mataimakin Waaiya, don taɓawa ta ratsa murfin. Ku bar “USB debugging” a kunne saboda shi (“Wireless debugging” zai iya kasancewa a kashe). Bayan wayar ta sake kunnuwa, ku sake kunna mataimakin daga shafin Allo.

Yanzu Waaiya tana zuwa a matsayin sabuwar manhaja a Android (Waaiya ɗaya ce da sabon suna), kuma wannan ba za ta ƙara samun sabuntawa ba. Saka sabuwar: saitunanku za su bi ta. Sannan ku yi saitin farko na sau ɗaya a cikinta, ku cire wannan.
An saka sabuwar Waaiya. Buɗe ta: za ta ɗauki saitunanku. Yi saitin farko na sau ɗaya, sannan ku cire wannan tsohuwar don kada su biyu su tace a lokaci ɗaya.
Tsohuwar Waaiya tana nan a kan wayar
Tsohuwar Waaiya (ta kafin siga 0.2.15) tana nan a wannan wayar. Cire ta don kada su biyu su tace a lokaci ɗaya.
